say:76:1810505011:0.female: Disguise magic can fail?! D-don't scare me like that!

choice_prompt:77:1810505014.female: So these two are living humans.

say:78:1810505012:0.female: How can you possibly know that? No, no, I'm demanding a refund when we get back. They never mentioned a risk this huge!

say:81:1810505014:0.female: So these two are living humans.

choice:3:0:1.male: Senea said this place had been abandoned...
choice:3:0:1.female: Senea said this place had been abandoned...

say:0:1810512001:0.text: Both of you, keep your distance. Don't get too deep into the fight.

say:1:1810512002:0.male: (Ugh... losing my magic is such a pain.)
say:1:1810512002:0.female: (Ugh... losing my magic is such a pain.)

say:0:1810517001:0.text: Hmph. You all managed to keep up? The Bone Hut's just ahead.
say:0:1810517001:0.source_cn: 哼，跟上来了？走快点，骨屋就在前面。

say:2:1810519001:0.text: It's not the full moon yet.

say:4:1810519003:0.text: I'll see if there's any usable magic to strengthen the village's defenses. Wouldn't want any of you living folk to start squealing like scared mice.
say:4:1810519003:0.source_cn: 老身要去研究一下，看看是否有可用的魔法可以加强夕染村的...

say:5:1810519004:0.text: You can move around freely, but don't stray too far from the hut. Be back before the full moon rises, got it?
say:5:1810519004:0.source_cn: 你们可以随意活动，但不可离骨屋太远，满月前必须返回，听...

say:9:1810519006:1.source_cn: 那就好，别给老身惹麻烦。

say:10:1810519007:1.text: *Sigh* Four troublesome brats all at once. Even in death, I get no peace...
say:10:1810519007:1.source_cn: 唉，一口气来了四个不省心的孩子，老身连死了也不得安宁……

say:15:1810519008:0.text: ... She hates the living, yet she took us in. I don't understand why.
say:15:1810519008:0.source_cn: ……她讨厌生者，但却收留了我们。我想不通缘由。

choice_prompt:16:1810519003.text: I'll see if there's any usable magic to strengthen the village's defenses. Wouldn't want any of you living folk to start squealing like scared mice.
choice_prompt:16:1810519003.source_cn: 老身要去研究一下，看看是否有可用的魔法可以加强夕染村的安全，免得哪位生者又畏惧得如同老鼠一般。

say:17:1810519009:0.text: But you said she's the one who rescued Baden from the Refinery.
say:17:1810519009:0.source_cn: 但你说过，是她将巴登从炼化间里救出来的。
say:17:1810519009:0.male: But you said she's the one who rescued Baden from the Refinery.
say:17:1810519009:0.female: But you said she's the one who rescued Baden from the Refinery.

say:18:1810519011:0.text: For the last time, I'm Rain, not Baden!
say:18:1810519011:0.source_cn: 喂，我再说一遍——我是里纳，不是巴登！

say:19:1810519012:0.text: Ba—Rain, don't say that. You have no idea how much effort Thane spent trying to find you. He's even sprouted extra wrinkles because of it.
say:19:1810519012:0.source_cn: 巴……里纳，不要这样说。你不知道瑟恩为了找到你花费了多...

say:20:1810519013:1.text: Really? No wonder he looks so much older than us.
say:20:1810519013:1.source_cn: 是吗？难怪他看起来比咱们两个年纪大不少。

say:21:1810519014:1.text: ... Heh. So you finally show your true colors in front of Estrilda.
say:21:1810519014:1.source_cn: ……呵，你终于在爱丝面前暴露本性了。

say:22:1810519015:1.text: I can't wait to see the look on your face when your memories come back. You're going to regret this. Don't say I didn't warn you.
say:22:1810519015:1.source_cn: 我很期待你恢复记忆以后的表情，你肯定会后悔。到时候，不...

say:23:1810519016:1.source_cn: 爱丝？她不是叫艾芙琳吗？

say:24:1810519017:1.text: Her name is Estrilda. She's your cousin. You grew up together, and you've always treated her with kindness.
say:24:1810519017:1.source_cn: 她叫爱丝特瑞达，是你的堂妹。她从小跟着你长大，是你一直...

say:25:1810519018:0.text: And I'm your comrade-in-arms, Thane. We'll talk more after your memories return.
say:25:1810519018:0.source_cn: 我是你的战友，瑟恩。剩下的等你恢复记忆后再说吧。

say:27:1810519020:1.text: Truth be told, I've started questioning my own past. I'm not a Graveborn, so it can't be memory loss from body replacements.
say:27:1810519020:1.source_cn: 老实说，我确实对自己的过去产生了一些疑问。我不是亡灵，...

say:28:1810519021:1.text: We don't have a sure way to bring your memories back yet. But we can try.
say:28:1810519021:1.source_cn: 我们暂时没有确切的能帮你找回记忆的办法，但总归可以做一...

say:29:1810519022:0.text: Maybe I can tell you about the past? You teaching me swordsmanship, taking me horseback riding, and...
say:29:1810519022:0.source_cn: 或许我可以给你讲讲过去的事？你教我练剑，带我去骑马兜风...

say:30:1810519023:1.text: Actually, it might be faster if you experienced those things again yourself.
say:30:1810519023:1.source_cn: 不，比起口述，还是让你再体验一遍来得快。

say:31:1810519024:1.text: Thane, you think too. You two went through way more together during your service than I ever did.
say:31:1810519024:1.source_cn: 瑟恩，你也想想看。你们服役时经历过的事情肯定比我多。

say:33:1810519026:0.text: But first, we need to make sure this place is secure. We can't rely solely on that Graveborn woman's treant.
say:33:1810519026:0.source_cn: 但我们必须优先确保此地的安全，只靠那亡灵妇人所说的树精...

say:36:1810519027:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that Graveborn earlier clearly recognized you.
say:36:1810519027:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that Graveborn earlier clearly recognized you.
say:36:1810519027:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that Graveborn earlier clearly recognized you.

say:37:1810519028:0.text: She also mentioned a <style="highlight">Void Relic</style>. Care to explain?
say:37:1810519028:0.male: She also mentioned a <style="highlight">Void Relic</style>. Care to explain?
say:37:1810519028:0.female: She also mentioned a <style="highlight">Void Relic</style>. Care to explain?

choice_prompt:38:1810519009.female: But you said she's the one who rescued Baden from the Refinery.

say:39:1810519029:1.female: I need to know whether whatever you're hiding could endanger us.

choice_prompt:40:1810519030.male: That's right. I can vouch for <style="stress"><player_name></style> too.
choice_prompt:40:1810519030.female: That's right. I can vouch for <style="stress"><player_name></style> too.

say:42:1810519030:0.female: That's right. I can vouch for <style="stress"><player_name></style> too.

say:43:1810519031:0.female: She saved both me and Eve—Estrilda.

say:44:1810519032:0.text: ... Very well. I'll trust your judgment. Even now.
say:44:1810519032:0.source_cn: ……好吧，巴登，我相信你的判断。即便是现在。

say:45:1810519038:1.text: It's "Rain"! At least until I get my memories back, I'm Rain.
say:45:1810519038:1.source_cn: 是“里纳”！至少在我恢复记忆以前，我还是里纳。

say:46:1810519039:1.text: It doesn't matter how much you argue, <style="highlight">Baden</style>.

say:47:1810519040:0.text: Why are you as stubborn as a gravestone?
say:47:1810519040:0.source_cn: 你怎么和墓石一样顽固？

say:50:1810519041:1.text: ... Were you two always this childish? I've never seen anything like it.
say:50:1810519041:1.source_cn: ……你们两个，难道以前就这么幼稚吗？真是从没见过你们这样。

say:51:1810519042:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Let's focus on how we might bring Rain's memories back.
say:51:1810519042:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Let's focus on how we might bring Rain's memories back.
say:51:1810519042:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right. Let's focus on how we might bring Rain's memories back.

say:54:1810519033:1.text: Exactly. If he wanted us dead, all it'd take is tossing a candle blossom at us.

say:54:1810519033:1.female: Exactly. If she wanted us dead, all it'd take is tossing a candle blossom at us.

say:55:1810519034:1.text: ... You're still absurdly optimistic. No different from before, Baden.

say:55:1810519034:1.male: ... You're still absurdly optimistic. No different from before, Baden.
say:55:1810519034:1.female: ... You're still absurdly optimistic. No different from before, Baden.

choice:40:1:2.male: If I wanted to hurt you, I wouldn't have waited this long.
choice:40:1:2.female: If I wanted to hurt you, I wouldn't have waited this long.

say:56:1810519035:0.female: But you have combat reflexes and awareness. You've either trained before... or you've faced real danger.

say:58:1810519036:0.text: Relax. <style="stress"><player_name></style> only just died. He doesn't know a single Graveborn spell, let alone pull off something this elaborate.
say:58:1810519036:0.male: Relax. <style="stress"><player_name></style> only just died. He doesn't know a single Graveborn spell, let alone pull off something this elaborate.
say:58:1810519036:0.female: Relax. <style="stress"><player_name></style> only just died. She doesn't know a single Graveborn spell, let alone pull off something this elaborate.

say:59:1810519037:0.text: Baden, if I were <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'd want to shut you up right about now.

say:59:1810519037:0.female: Baden, if I were <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'd want to shut you up right about now.

choice:40:2:3.male: What's there to be afraid of? I don't have any magic.
choice:40:2:3.female: What's there to be afraid of? I don't have any magic.

choice:38:0:1.source_cn: ……我觉得帮里纳找回记忆更重要！
choice:38:0:1.male: ... Helping Rain recover his memories is more important!
choice:38:0:1.female: ... Helping Rain recover his memories is more important!

say:60:1810519043:0.text: ... You want me to help that Graveborn?
say:60:1810519043:0.male: ... You want me to help that Graveborn?
say:60:1810519043:0.female: ... You want me to help that Graveborn?

choice_prompt:61:1810519031.source_cn: <male>他</male><female>她</female>可是救了我和艾……爱丝的命呢！
choice_prompt:61:1810519031.male: He saved both me and Eve—Estrilda.
choice_prompt:61:1810519031.female: She saved both me and Eve—Estrilda.

say:65:1810519047:1.female: Estrilda. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will set up defenses. You try to help Baden regain his memories.

choice:9:2:3.text: You really have no sense of humor!
choice:9:2:3.male: You really have no sense of humor!
choice:9:2:3.female: You really have no sense of humor!

choice:3:2:3.text: Why don't we just run away?
choice:3:2:3.male: Why don't we just run away?
choice:3:2:3.female: Why don't we just run away?

say:0:1810538101:0.source_cn: 快回夕染村吧，我们得赶在班题斯军队来之前回去！

say:0:1810539101:0.text: Oh? You already got Hilda's keepsake?
say:0:1810539101:0.source_cn: 哦，希尔达的东西这么快取回来了？
say:0:1810539101:0.male: Oh? You already got Hilda's keepsake?
say:0:1810539101:0.female: Oh? You already got Hilda's keepsake?

say:2:1810540101:1.text: Baba, it's bad! We were ambushed by Bantus soldiers right outside the village. A few of them got away to report back!
say:2:1810540101:1.source_cn: 婆婆，不好了！我们刚出村子就遇到了埋伏的班题斯士兵，有...

say:3:1810540102:1.text: Those rotten lapdogs... They're already this close?!
say:3:1810540102:1.source_cn: ——刚出村子就遇到？！这群狗腿子……竟敢离得这么近！

say:6:1810540103:0.text: They must have realized something's wrong with the treant. They'll be attacking soon. We need to prepare for a fight.
say:6:1810540103:0.source_cn: 他们肯定已经发现了希尔达的异常，很快就会攻入夕染村，我...

choice_prompt:7:1810540103.text: They must have realized something's wrong with the treant. They'll be attacking soon. We need to prepare for a fight.
choice_prompt:7:1810540103.source_cn: 他们肯定已经发现了希尔达的异常，很快就会攻入夕染村，我们必须做好战斗准备。

say:8:1810540106:0.text: Thane, you have more experience fighting Bantus soldiers than any of us. What do you think?
say:8:1810540106:0.source_cn: 瑟恩，你对付班题斯士兵的经验比我多，你有什么建议？

say:9:1810540107:1.text: Most Graveborn have more fragile bodies than the living. Their movement and reflexes are slower than a normal human's.
say:9:1810540107:1.source_cn: 绝大部分亡灵的肉体都远比生者脆弱，行动力和反应力都不及...

say:10:1810540108:1.text: We used to set up <style="highlight">rolling logs</style> and take advantage of the terrain to wipe out the weaker ones first, then deal with the rest.

say:11:1810540109:1.text: I noticed a steep slope north of the village earlier. We could set it up there.
say:11:1810540109:1.source_cn: 我玩捉迷藏的时候有观察过，村子北面有一处滑坡，可以在那...

say:14:1810540110:1.text: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.
say:14:1810540110:1.male: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.
say:14:1810540110:1.female: Right! That's where <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I were ambushed. The terrain there is really steep.

say:15:1810540111:1.text: Then we <style="highlight">barricade every other entrance to the village</style>, and force them to advance through that slope.
say:15:1810540111:1.source_cn: 那就<style=highlight>把其他方向连通村...

say:16:1810540112:1.text: Once they're in position, we release the logs. It won't take them all out, but it should thin their numbers.
say:16:1810540112:1.source_cn: 然后看准时机，把滚木放下去。虽然不能消灭所有敌人，但也...

say:17:1810540113:1.text: But... what if they manage to dodge them?
say:17:1810540113:1.source_cn: 如果……我是说如果，他们成功避开了滚木呢？

say:18:1810540114:1.text: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.
say:18:1810540114:1.male: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.
say:18:1810540114:1.female: I'll hold them off. You and <style="stress"><player_name></style> retreat to the Bone Hut and look for a way out.

say:19:1810540115:1.text: That's too dangerous! You only have one arm, you're already at a disadvantage. Let me help.
say:19:1810540115:1.source_cn: 那也太危险了！你只有一条手臂，本来就有劣势，我也来帮忙吧。

say:20:1810540116:0.text: No. You stay with Baba Muriel and protect her. They're after the two of you. She knows the area, but she might not be able to outrun the soldiers.
say:20:1810540116:0.source_cn: 你留在穆婆婆身边保护她。敌人的目标是你们两个，她熟悉环...

say:24:1810540118:0.text: I'm fighting with you. I've recovered enough.
say:24:1810540118:0.source_cn: 瑟恩，我要和你一起战斗，我的身体已经没有大碍了。

say:25:1810540119:1.text: That assassin we ran into before entering the village is bound to show up again. I'll handle her.
say:25:1810540119:1.source_cn: 进入夕染村之前遇到的那个杀手，她肯定会再度出现，我来对付她。

say:26:1810540120:1.text: She's an assassin, Estrilda. She's not like the soldiers you've fought before.
say:26:1810540120:1.source_cn: 她是刺客，和你之前交战的班题斯士兵不同。

choice_prompt:27:1810540121.text: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.source_cn: 你看，<style=stress><player_name></style>都这么说了。放心吧瑟恩，上次交手时，我已经摸清她的实力。
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.male: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
choice_prompt:27:1810540121.female: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.

say:28:1810540121:0.text: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
say:28:1810540121:0.male: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.
say:28:1810540121:0.female: See? Even <style="stress"><player_name></style> agrees. Don't worry, I already know what she's capable of.

say:29:1810540122:1.text: ... I trust you. Let's go <style="highlight">prepare the rolling logs</style>. The more, the better.
say:29:1810540122:1.source_cn: 好，我相信你。走吧，我们去<style=highlig...

say:32:1810540123:0.text: And Baba Muriel... Keep trying to treat Hilda. If she wakes up, it'll help us a lot.
say:32:1810540123:0.source_cn: ……至于穆婆婆，继续尝试治疗希尔达。若她能够恢复，就对...

say:33:1810540124:0.text: Hmph! Since you've finally said something sensible for once, I suppose I'll listen to you.
say:33:1810540124:0.source_cn: 哼，看在你难得说了句人话的份上，老身就姑且听你一回。

choice:27:0:1.text: Don't worry, she's not that tough.
choice:27:0:1.male: Don't worry, she's not that tough.
choice:27:0:1.female: Don't worry, she's not that tough.

choice:27:1:2.text: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!
choice:27:1:2.male: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!
choice:27:1:2.female: Estrilda's fast enough to handle her!

choice:7:0:1.text: Rain and I thought the same.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 我和里纳也是这么推测的
choice:7:0:1.male: Rain and I thought the same.
choice:7:0:1.female: Rain and I thought the same.

say:35:1810540104:0.text: With the meager magic you brats have? Not a chance.
say:35:1810540104:0.source_cn: 就凭老身和你们这点魔力，没有别的办法。

say:36:1810540105:0.text: If we want to stop them, we'll have to do it another way.
say:36:1810540105:0.source_cn: 想要拦住他们，只能从其他地方下功夫。

choice:7:1:2.text: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 还有没有其他办法能帮希尔达恢复？
choice:7:1:2.male: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?
choice:7:1:2.female: Is there any other way to help Hilda recover?

say:0:1810541101:0.text: Let's chop some wood first. We'll need it for barricades and rolling logs.
say:0:1810541101:0.source_cn: 先去砍些木头。堵路和制造滚木都需要用到。

narration:0:1810542101:1.text: You use the chopped wood to build simple barricades.
narration:0:1810542101:1.male: You use the chopped wood to build simple barricades.
narration:0:1810542101:1.female: You use the chopped wood to build simple barricades.

say:2:1810542102:1.text: Let's block the east path first.
say:2:1810542102:1.male: Let's block the east path first.
say:2:1810542102:1.female: Let's block the east path first.

narration:0:1810543101:1.text: You reinforce the road leading into the village with barricades.
narration:0:1810543101:1.male: You reinforce the road leading into the village with barricades.
narration:0:1810543101:1.female: You reinforce the road leading into the village with barricades.

say:2:1810543102:1.text: Good. Now let's set up the traps on the northern slope.
say:2:1810543102:1.source_cn: 好了，再去北侧的滑坡布置滚木陷阱吧。

say:1:1810544101:1.text: Let's head back to the Bone Hut. We can't afford to split up.
say:1:1810544101:1.source_cn: 回骨屋吧。我们战力太少，不能分散。

say:0:1810549201:0.text: This must be it. Let's hurry back to the Bone Hut.
say:0:1810549201:0.source_cn: 这应该就是穆婆婆说的东西了……赶快带回骨屋去吧。
say:0:1810549201:0.male: This must be it. Let's hurry back to the Bone Hut.
say:0:1810549201:0.female: This must be it. Let's hurry back to the Bone Hut.

say:4:1810551201:0.text: There, that should do it. Hilda, the pain's gone now. Relax...
say:4:1810551201:0.source_cn: 这样便好了。希尔达，你身上已经不疼了，放松些……

say:5:1810551202:0.text: Hilda is still breathing heavily. Her body and soul don't seem fully in sync, and her reactions remain sluggish.
say:5:1810551202:0.source_cn: “希尔达”仍然喘着粗气。不知是不是因为灵魂与躯体的不匹...

say:6:1810551203:0.text: Baba Muriel hums that song again, gently resting her left hand on Hilda's shoulder, patting gently and rhythmically.
say:6:1810551203:0.source_cn: 仿佛想要安抚她一样，穆婆婆再次哼起那首歌谣，又伸出左手...

say:10:1810551204:0.text: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.
say:10:1810551204:0.source_cn: 温柔哼唱声里，你注意到了瑟恩和里纳的视线。它们不约而同...
say:10:1810551204:0.male: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.
say:10:1810551204:0.female: Rain and Thane both watch quietly. Their eyes are fixed on her left hand.

say:11:1810551205:0.text: Whenever Baba comforts someone, she always pats their left shoulder with her left hand... It feels so familiar.
say:11:1810551205:0.source_cn: 婆婆安慰人的时候，总是喜欢用左手拍别人的左肩……我一直...

say:12:1810551206:0.text: Even when I had just woken up and knew absolutely nothing, as long as she patted my shoulder like that, I would slowly calm down. I just couldn't help but trust her...
say:12:1810551206:0.source_cn: 哪怕是刚刚醒来，什么都不知道的时候，只要婆婆这样拍拍我...

say:13:1810551207:0.text: Was that... because of Bayanu too?
say:13:1810551207:0.source_cn: 这也是因为巴亚茄先生吗？

say:14:1810551208:0.text: Yes. Back when we went to the Whispering Isles, we were young. We'd just received... bad news. That's how he comforted us.
say:14:1810551208:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们去幽声群岛的时候还很年轻，当时收到了……一些不...

say:18:1810551210:1.text: I'm starting to believe what you and Estrilda told me. But I don't know when I'll ever remember my past...
say:18:1810551210:1.source_cn: ……我开始有些相信你和爱丝说的话了。但我不知道什么时候...

say:19:1810551211:0.text: It's okay. We've found you already. Take your time.
say:19:1810551211:0.source_cn: 没关系，我们已经找到你了，慢慢来！

say:20:1810551212:1.text: Yes. We have plenty of time ahead of us.
say:20:1810551212:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们还有很长的时间。

narration:21:1810551213:0.text: Under the strange song, the full moon slowly wanes...
narration:21:1810551213:0.source_cn: 在奇特的歌声之中，圆月渐渐变化……

narration:22:1810551214:0.text: Before it disappears completely, Hilda finally regains her strength.
narration:22:1810551214:0.source_cn: 赶在满月消失前，“希尔达”终于恢复了力量

say:1:1810552201:0.text: Capture them alive. Don't kill them.

say:0:1810560001:0.source_cn: 赶快换上本地亡灵居民的衣服吧。

say:0:1810561001:0.text: That should keep us from being noticed on the way to <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>.
say:0:1810561001:0.source_cn: 这样应该就不会被守卫发现了，不过去<style=hig...
say:0:1810561001:0.male: That should keep us from being noticed on the way to <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>.
say:0:1810561001:0.female: That should keep us from being noticed on the way to <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>.

say:3:1810563001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you make it to Twilight Village?
say:3:1810563001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you make it to Twilight Village?
say:3:1810563001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you make it to Twilight Village?

choice_prompt:4:1810563001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you make it to Twilight Village?
choice_prompt:4:1810563001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you make it to Twilight Village?

say:5:1810563002:0.text: Baba Muriel and Rain were captured? Oh no...
say:5:1810563002:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆和里纳先生被军队抓走了？这……

say:6:1810563003:0.text: I can see why you're worried. You came to me because you think I can help, correct?
say:6:1810563003:0.source_cn: 你们三位想必十分忧心吧。来找我，是认定我能帮你们做些什...

say:7:1810563004:1.text: Speak freely. You're not troubling me at all.
say:7:1810563004:1.source_cn: 请直言，无需担忧是否会为我添麻烦。

say:8:1810563005:0.text: Is there a way to get past the lockdown and send humans back to the Lightbearer Empire?
say:8:1810563005:0.source_cn: 你知道如何避开诺珐斯的戒严，送生者返回耀光帝国吗？

say:11:1810563008:1.text: Since the lockdown started, many audience members who snuck in have been stranded here. The Bantus officers aren't exactly welcoming, and since the theater had to cancel all performances, everyone is desperate to leave.
say:11:1810563008:1.source_cn: 戒严开始之后，很多偷渡而来的观众被迫滞留在诺珐斯。班题...

say:12:1810563009:1.text: The Seasong Theater has been working behind the scenes to find a way to send them back. Fortunately, things are going smoothly. We should have a solid plan in two or three days.
say:12:1810563009:1.source_cn: 实际上，海歌剧院一直在从中斡旋，寻找送他们返回耀光帝国...

say:13:1810563010:1.text: <style="highlight">You can leave with them.</style> That way, you'll avoid the inspections.

choice_prompt:14:1810563010.text: <style="highlight">You can leave with them.</style> That way, you'll avoid the inspections.
choice_prompt:14:1810563010.source_cn: <style=highlight>你们可以和这些观众们一同离开</style>，这样能够避开班题斯的审查。

say:15:1810563011:1.text: If nothing goes wrong, yes. They will leave a day or two after we get confirmation.
say:15:1810563011:1.source_cn: 如果不出意外，传回消息后一两日便会启程。

say:18:1810563013:1.text: Of course it is. Nearly every stowaway carries souvenirs with candle blossoms. If those enter the Lightbearer Empire, it could be disastrous.
say:18:1810563013:1.source_cn: ——当然不妥！几乎每个偷渡者手中都有赤烛蕊制成的周边，...

say:19:1810563014:1.text: There's no hiding it anymore. You have to tell Senea everything and delay their departure.
say:19:1810563014:1.source_cn: 事已至此，已经无法再隐瞒这可怕的真相了。只有将一切告诉...
say:19:1810563014:1.male: There's no hiding it anymore. You have to tell Senea everything and delay their departure.
say:19:1810563014:1.female: There's no hiding it anymore. You have to tell Senea everything and delay their departure.

say:20:1810563015:0.text: You explain everything: Estrilda's infection, the danger of candle blossoms to the living, and the <style="highlight">Syndicate's scheme involving Senea's shows</style>...
say:20:1810563015:0.source_cn: 于是你简明扼要地讲述了前因后果，包括爱丝的感染、赤烛蕊...

say:22:1810563016:0.text: So it was the Adamant Syndicate?!
say:22:1810563016:0.male: So it was the Adamant Syndicate?!
say:22:1810563016:0.female: So it was the Adamant Syndicate?!

say:23:1810563017:0.text: I'm so sorry. I never imagined the flowers were part of a scheme... it was suggested by <style="highlight">someone I trusted deeply</style>.
say:23:1810563017:0.source_cn: 非常抱歉。我从未想过利用赤烛蕊制作纪念品竟然会是一个阴...

say:25:1810563019:1.text:
...
Lady Tephesia, the ruler of Novaris.

...
Lady Tephesia, the ruler of Novaris.

say:27:1810563020:1.source_cn: 我很久之前就知道苔佩希阁下与黑金商会来往密切，譬如帮助...

say:28:1810563021:1.text: She's still the ruler of this city... and I considered her a friend. I cannot blame her for trying to bring business to our city, even if it involved the Syndicate.
say:28:1810563021:1.source_cn: 她毕竟是诺珐斯的领主，也被我视作朋友。我无法苛责她为诺...

say:29:1810563022:1.text: If she's involved in something like this, her rank within the Syndicate must be quite high.
say:29:1810563022:1.source_cn: 她能参与这种谋划，说明她在黑金商会内部的地位不会太低。

say:30:1810563023:1.text: Think about it. She was the one who ordered tight security over the Gravebloom Fields, and she holds the antidote. She knew everything from the start!

choice_prompt:31:1810563023.text: Think about it. She was the one who ordered tight security over the Gravebloom Fields, and she holds the antidote. She knew everything from the start!
choice_prompt:31:1810563023.source_cn: 仔细想想，苍骸花海是她下令严加看守的，解药也在她手中，她当然比任何人都清楚赤烛蕊的危害！一切都有迹可循，不是吗？

say:32:1810563024:1.text: I'll have the theater halt the plan and find another way to keep the visitors calm.
say:32:1810563024:1.source_cn: 嗯，我会让海歌剧院暂停这个计划，再想其他办法安抚观众。

say:33:1810563025:1.text: I'll also try to recall as many souvenirs as possible... but I can't guarantee all of them.
say:33:1810563025:1.source_cn: 另外，我也会和观众们沟通，回收赤烛蕊制成的纪念品。只是...

say:35:1810563026:1.text: ... She has already broken my trust.
say:35:1810563026:1.male: ... She has already broken my trust.
say:35:1810563026:1.female: ... She has already broken my trust.

say:37:1810563029:1.text: From your tone, it sounds like this manor isn't normally accessible.
say:37:1810563029:1.source_cn: 听你的语气，这座庄园似乎没办法通过正常的方式进入。

say:38:1810563030:1.text: Yes. There are no physical roads leading to it. Only those invited can travel there <style="highlight">by carriage, during a new moon</style>.

document:3:607:0.text:
Dear Merlin,

I learned about your recent visit to the Gravebloom Fields and your encounter with a candle blossom-infected human. I have some important information regarding this matter.

The <style="highlight">Adamant Syndicate</style> plotted to spread the candle blossom plague throughout the Lightbearer Empire by distributing the flowers at the Seasong Theater. The harmful effects of candle blossom on the living are as follows:

(Below is a small piece of trimmed paper, written in handwriting completely different from the text above.)



Upon contact with a living being, candle blossoms immediately begin parasitic growth, draining the host's vitality. Symptoms may include hallucinations, numbness, or total loss of the senses. Once the flowers spread throughout the entire body, the host will die.

After the host dies, <style="highlight">the flowers will spread outward from the place of death</style> in search of new hosts. As such, an <style="highlight">outbreak</style> is inevitable if they are brought into areas densely populated by the living.

These properties allow the Graveborn to use candle blossoms to dispose of severed limbs that still retain traces of vitality. The flowers have little effect on the Graveborn, presumably because they repel the force of death that sustains the Graveborn.



(The handwriting below reverts to that of the previous paragraphs.)

The shapeshifting spell used to disguise the human stowaways is derived from the force of death, so they won't be infected until the spell wears off. Since they will remain in Novaris until the show ends, there is no cause for concern for the time being. Keep up your disguise and stay safe.

<align="right">Mordred

梅林：
注意到你曾前往苍骸花海，且与一位被赤烛蕊感染的生者同行，特送来相关情报。
<style="highlight">黑金商会</style>曾计划利用赤烛蕊危害耀光帝国，海歌剧院所发放的纪念品即是其中之一。赤烛蕊对生者的具体危害如下：
（下面贴着一小张经过剪裁的信纸，字迹与上面完全不同）

赤烛蕊以生命力为养料。生者一旦接触，即刻便会被寄生，随之可能出现的症状包括幻觉、五感麻痹甚至丧失，直至赤烛蕊遍布全身，失去生命。
生者死后，<style="highlight">赤烛蕊将以其死地为中心向外扩散</style>，寻找其他寄生对象。因此，若赤烛蕊传入生者聚集地，必将<style="highlight">造成瘟疫</style>。
基于同样的原理，赤烛蕊可用于处理仍蕴含生命力的废肢，但其对亡灵躯体的影响微乎其微，推测原因是其排斥维持亡灵生存的死亡之力。

（以下部分的字迹与前几段相同）
偷渡者所接受之伪装魔法同样源于死亡之力，在魔法解除前不会被赤烛蕊感染。演出结束前他们无法离开诺珐斯，不必担心。做好伪装，保护自己。
<align="right">莫德雷德

Dear Merlin,

Word has reached me that the Void Relic in your possession is the very one Bantus lost over a decade ago. Grezhul, the most loyal servant of Thoran, will stop at nothing to reclaim it. You are in grave danger.

With Novaris under full lockdown, all information is being funneled directly to Grezhul. I've enclosed a set of <style="highlight">local attire</style> to help with your disguise. Remember, never enter the city unless absolutely necessary.

Furthermore, keeping humans in tow is extremely dangerous. Send them away as soon as possible, or you'll be implicated! You can <style="highlight">ask Senea</style> for help regarding the arrangements.

Should the journey to Novaris prove unfeasible, you may knock them unconscious and leave them on the roadside. My messenger will arrange for their safe return to the Lightbearer Empire.

<align="right">Mordred

诺珐斯已全面戒严，所有消息都将汇总于格瑞泽尔勒处。随信附赠一套<style="highlight">本地居民衣物</style>，必要时刻可助你伪装。但切记：不到万不得已之时，不可冒险进入城内。
此外，与生者同行极为危险，务必尽快将其送走！否则于你而言只会是拖累！具体事宜可<style="highlight">询问塞涅</style>，她会有办法的。
又及：若返回城内太过困难，可将其打昏弃于路边隐蔽处，信使看到后会寻人送其返回耀光帝国。
